business_summary: Ohki Healthcare Holdings Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and other products. The company is involved in the sale, import, and export of pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, medical equipment, cosmetics, poisons, deleterious substances, chemicals, reagents, measuring instruments, optical equipment, electrical appliances, and communication equipment; and veterinary drugs, veterinary quasi-drugs, veterinary medical equipment, pet supplies, feed, and feed additives. It also sells, imports, and exports textile products, hygiene products, cosmetics, beauty products, health equipment, sports goods, leisure goods, nursing care products, convenient nursing care products, toys, stationery, household goods, daily necessities, food products, food additives, alcoholic beverages, rice, salt, and tobacco; and sale of pesticides, fertilizers, horticultural supplies, and agricultural supplies. In addition, the company engages in warehouse operations; development, sale, and rental of information processing systems, logistics system equipment, and software; management and dispensing of pharmacies and drugstores. Further, it is involved in the wholesale of food and contact lenses, as well as cosmetics and miscellaneous goods; retail of pharmaceuticals; and application for licenses and permits. Ohki Healthcare Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1658 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
